SQUAD GENERAL
/ACCEPT: Accepts a squad invitation. /DECLINE: Rejects a squad invitation. /DEMOTE (PLAYER): Demotes a player's squad rank. /LEAVE: Removes you from your squad. /INVITE (PLAYER): Invites named player to join your squad. /INVITES: Turns off and on your ability to recieve invites. /PROMOTE (PLAYER): Promotes a player's squad rank. /RECRUIT (PLAYER): Invites named player to join your squad. /RECRUITING ON|OFF: Toggles your ability to receive new recruits (note: squad recruiting must be enabled in the Squad tab). Can also be set through the OPTIONS pane of the SQUADS tab. /WHO: Displays a list of all squad members online currently playing for the same side as yourself.
SQUAD LEADERSHIP
/CREATE: Allows creation of a new squad - NOTE - Must have 5 players to start new squad. /DISBAND: Disbands current squad (Restricted to CO only). /RESIGN (PLAYER): Resigns your position as Commanding Officer to the specified player. Note: Squad leaders cannot leave a squad, they must appoint a new CO with /resign first. /VOTING: Enable or disable voting for the squad CO. Can also be set through the SQUADS tab. /VOTECO (PLAYER): Places a vote for the specified squad member to become the new Commanding Officer of your squad. No effect if the CO has disabled VOTING. Please note: The CO's decision is final. /REMOVE (PLAYER): Removes a player from the squad
